title: `entire agent add/list` does not discover external agents

verdict.rationale: The agent group was introduced as a purely additive reorganization of existing commands, and nothing in the evidence shows that skipping external agent discovery in add/list/remove was chosen. The discovery gating evidence concerns trust and feature flags in other call sites, not a decision to exclude the agent noun-group.

feat(cli): introduce noun-group command structure (#1061)

Reorganize the flat top-level command surface around four noun groups
(session, checkpoint, agent, doctor) so users can discover and reason
about commands the way they think about the work — by domain noun,
not verb.

Phase 1 is purely additive:
  - 4 new noun groups with sub-commands
  - 8 new sub-commands: session current, agent {list,add,remove},
    checkpoint {list,show,diff}, doctor {logs,bundle}
  - All previous top-level verbs (rewind, resume, attach, explain,
    trace, search) remain registered as silent permanent aliases
  - configure prints a one-time deprecation warning pointing to agent
  - sessions stays as a Cobra alias of session

No prior invocation breaks. Full implementation tracked in #1061.

Remove Gemini CLI support

Drop the geminicli agent package and everything that registered, installed,
captured, reviewed, summarized, imported, or resumed Gemini sessions, plus
its E2E runner, CI matrix entries, skills, and docs.

Two things stay for users who already used Gemini with Entire:

- Hooks left in .gemini/settings.json: `entire hooks gemini <verb>` is now a
  silent no-op, and `entire doctor`, `entire disable --uninstall`, and
  `entire agent remove gemini` strip Entire's entries while keeping the
  user's own hooks and settings. Uninstall's preflight and summary see them
  even when they are the only artifact left.
- Historical checkpoints: a read-only parser in transcript/geminilegacy
  keeps explain, summaries, and chunk reassembly working for checkpoints
  tagged "Gemini CLI".

Task checkpoints now chunk with the session's agent type instead of
DetectAgentTypeFromContent, which only ever recognized Gemini.
